modules.name: BlossomUI-gtk3-theme
build-commands: install -d /usr/share/runtime/share/themes/BlossomUI/gtk-3.0/blossomui-gtk-assets && install -m644 gtk/build/gtk3-light.css /usr/share/runtime/share/themes/BlossomUI/gtk-3.0/gtk.css && install -m644 gtk/build/gtk3-dark.css /usr/share/runtime/share/themes/BlossomUI/gtk-3.0/gtk-dark.css && install -m644 gtk/assets/*.png gtk/assets/*.svg /usr/share/runtime/share/themes/BlossomUI/gtk-3.0/blossomui-gtk-assets/
